description: FTB 3514 Step 6 worksheet (2025 booklet p. 7): earned income $10,000 (1 child) reads the EITC Table at $1,162 (printed row 9,951-10,000); federal AGI $16,000 (interest 6,000) differs and is above the $6,998 line-5 floor, so line 5 looks the table up at AGI: printed row 15,951-16,000 = $509; 'enter the smaller amount on line 6' -> $509.
